cells.gaps: No source says any chiefdom, sector, territory or commune office is working over a connection: the Starlink kits in Haut-Uélé are reported handed over on 17 March 2026, not installed or in use, and who pays the subscription is not stated. The GovNet tender of June 2026 for 7 governorates and 44 territories is a pilot with bids due in July 2026, financed by the World Bank and AFD, and no building is said to be connected. The 45 is a count of entities given kits in one province, with no total, and no domestic budget line is on record.
cells.note: Stage 2 because the connection evidence is kits handed to 45 chiefdoms and sectors of one province and a June 2026 pilot tender for governorates and territories, both preparation. Stage 3 needs an institutional connection live in some local government offices outside the capital, and none is stated.
